description_en: Queries API security user asset statistics
description_zh: 查询API安全用户资产统计
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-user-asset --instance-id waf-cn-uax37ijm000 --data-type asset_num --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeUserAsset

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query instance ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of statistics. Valid values:
asset_num: total number of API assets.
asset_active: number of active APIs.
asset_newborn: number of APIs added today.
asset_offline: number of inactive APIs.
asset_bot: number of APIs with bot requests.
asset_cross_border: number of APIs with cross-border data transfer.
sensitive_api: number of APIs with sensitive data in responses.
sensitive_domain: number of sites with sensitive data in responses
parameters.help_zh:
统计类型。取值：
asset_num：表示API资产总数。
asset_active：表示活跃API数。
asset_newborn：表示今日新增数。
asset_offline：表示失活API数。
asset_bot：表示存在机器请求API数。
asset_cross_border：表示跨境数据传输API数。
sensitive_api：表示响应涉敏API数。
sensitive_domain：表示响应涉敏站点数
parameters.name: data_type

parameters.help_en:
The query time in UNIX timestamp format (UTC). Unit: seconds.
<notice>This parameter is deprecated.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
查询的时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。
<notice>参数已弃用。></notice>
parameters.name: days

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.
This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html operation to obtain hybrid cloud cluster information
parameters.help_zh:
混合云集群 ID。
只针对混合云场景，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html获取混合云集群信息
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

TimeStamp.description_en: The time of the statistics in UNIX timestamp format (UTC). Unit: seconds
TimeStamp.description_zh: 统计的时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒
